avis.titre: Noticeable Difference in Texture on My Eyes
avis.texte: I bought this in August of 2023 (And it's still lasted me to February of 2024!) over concerns of crepe-y skin on my eyes. I have noticed a difference in the texture and firmness of my eyelids after using this product throughout the months. I remember applying eyeshadow and seeing all the fine lines, and they have greatly reduced over time. I don't think I ever really had a problem with dark circles so I can't speak to it's affect on pigmentation. Also I don't use this product daily. I use it maybe every other day, and I use half a pump at a time because I feel that that's enough. So your mileage may vary regarding product lifespan. I would be careful with this product if your eye area is sensitive however. Basically any time I applied this when I had tender skin around my eyes from using a makeup wipe or crying too hard (like we do sometimes lol), it would result in puffiness and sometimes even mucus forming from my eyes. So I would recommend skipping this product for the day/night if you know your eye area is a bit compromised and opt for a more soothing option instead to avoid irritation. So really if I could, I would rate this 4.5 stars because of that one thing. But I do consider that to be a bit of user error on my part, and the good results I've had from this product out weight the negatives.

I have finished the full sized version of the cream after about 3 months of applying it every night before bed. I bought this, as I have these ungodly dark circles under my eyes for someone in their early 20s. For that use, I am not… impressed. Because these changes are so hard to see when you look in the mirror everyday, I ended up trying to consistently take weekly photos of my face to try and document any changes. After reviewing them, and how the product makes me ultimately feel, this is where I landed: Did it make my eyes feel hydrated? Yes! Did it brighten my eyes? Kind of; it did, but I expected a bit more after hashing out $65, and all the hype around it. Did it help my dark circles? Again, kind of (emphasis on kind of), but was expecting more. I also noticed that the product did in fact have a *minor* burn when you get a smidge too close to your eye. User error? Definitely, but something to note if you have sensitive eyes, which mine are most certainly not. I ended up purchasing some Peter Thomas Roth eye patches to use in conjunction about halfway through the bottle, and felt like both these products combined did a really good job. I felt like they both complimented each other, and helped enhance this creams effects a lot more. However, once again, this cream on its own, I was not super impressed. Overall, I think this product needs a bit more work with the potency; I wouldn't mind spending more, but if this is the baseline I'm not enamored to continue purchasing it
